messages:
amanda: Thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-up on the security/compliance segment. We have a couple of customers asking for ISO evidence around KMS BYOK and VPC audit exports. Can leadership share what minimum artifacts we should be preparing?

leo: Short list off the cuff: key creation/rotation timestamps, KMS access ACLs, key usage logs, and the policy docs that describe rotation/retention. Also proof of export pipeline for audit logs. Will confirm exact ISO control mappings. :+1:

mayur: For the audit log export — ops currently ships logs to secure S3 buckets with daily manifests. The blocker is that customers want CSV-compatible exports showing principal, action, resource, and timestamp. Is that a hard requirement?

olivia: Customers usually accept JSONL but ISO reviewers like tabular artifacts. We can produce a CSV view derived from JSONL. Main ask: retention window and immutability proof (WORM or hardened write-only buckets).

amanda: Ok — who's owning a checklist we can share with sales/support? We need something short for customer-ready answers and an internal action list.

leo: I'll own the checklist. Plan: 1) map artifacts to ISO control IDs, 2) export examples (CSV + JSONL), 3) retention & immutability evidence, 4) KMS BYOK rotation logs + attestation. Aim to post v1 in 48 hours.

dina: Two quick Qs for the checklist: do we include ephemeral request traces (prefix/KV cache hits) or only control-plane logs? Customers asking about inference data lineage.

mayur: For data lineage, we can include control-plane pointers (request IDs + model/version) but not full payloads unless explicitly requested under NDA. We need to be careful about exposing PII.

olivia: Agreed. Checklist should call out export scopes: control-plane metadata (ok), payloads (require customer approval + data sharing agreement).

amanda: Can we also get a short how-to snippet for ops to produce a CSV export? Might save time during customer calls.

leo: Draft CLI snippet below (ops-only, requires audit role):

```
redwood-audit export --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-31 --format csv --fields timestamp,principal,action,resource --output s3://redwood-audit-exports/iso-2026-03.csv
```

leo: That will create a signed manifest + checksum. We'll add an example attachment to the checklist.

amanda: Great. Also can we set up a 30-min office hours next week for customers who need walk-throughs? Sales keeps getting corner cases during demos.

mayur: +1. I can join with ops to show the export flow and how we redact payloads.

olivia: I'll coordinate times. Posting a Doodle by EOD.

security-bot: Reminder: please follow the evidence labeling convention when uploading artifacts: /evidence/ISO/2026/Q1/{customer-or-internal}-{artifact-type}-{date}.jsonl :rotating_light:

amanda: Awesome, thanks everyone — looking forward to the checklist. If anyone needs me to escalate to leadership for additional resources, ping me. :handshake:

leo: Will post v1 here and tag @amanda @dina.

(edited)
